diagnosis: The VPC peering termination endpoint relies on express-openapi-validator to check that vpcId and peeringId conform to AWS resource ID patterns, but performs no tenancy or ownership check. Any authenticated user can issue termination commands against VPC peering links belonging to other cloud accounts, causing network outages.
